test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the following carefully and answer the question that follows.

9 B Q = 5 R $ J @ 4 * P & 9 M X # G

Which of the given options is exactly midway between B and X?
solution:
Given Series:-

9 B Q = 5 R $ J @ 4 * P & 9 M X # G

Exactly midway between B and X,

9 __B__ Q = 5 R $ J __@__ 4 * P & 9 M __X__ # G

Hence, the correct answer is **'@'**.
